Hi, we’re Tails.com 👋 🐾 

We’re a Pack of dog experts, owners and lovers who know every pup is one-of-a-kind. We’re all about feeding your dog’s individuality – 100% tailored food based on their age, breed, zoomie level and tastebuds (seriously, we can handle those picky eaters.)

Subscribe for all the canine content you’re craving:

Free vet & behaviourist advice (cha-ching) 
Training hacks (for the foodies AND the non-foodies) 
Dog-friendly recipes (with flavours for every craving 
Discussion on all things dog (and what makes them special)

It’s great to have you with us.
